title: Elm Ridge Apartments
subtitle: The 130-unit Airport Boulevard property up for a city housing note on Oct. 8
alt: Map of east-central Austin marking Elm Ridge Apartments at 1190 Airport Boulevard, the roughly 130-unit low-income apartment property whose acquisition and rehabilitation the Austin Housing Finance Corporation will hold a public hearing on for a note issue of up to 33 million dollars on October 8, 2026
source: Austin Housing Finance Corporation public hearing notice
